picks.title: Scoop: Trump admin blocks foreign access to Anthropic's most powerful AI
picks.why_it_matters: Export controls on frontier AI models signal a new regulatory regime that could reshape competitive dynamics for AI startups and create openings for open-source alternatives in international markets.

picks.title: Electric motors with no rare earths
picks.why_it_matters: Rare earth-free motor technology removes a critical supply chain bottleneck for EV and robotics startups, potentially unlocking new hardware ventures previously constrained by China's mineral dominance.

picks.title: CRISPR tech selectively shreds cancer cells, including 'undruggable' cancers
picks.why_it_matters: A breakthrough in precision oncology targeting previously untreatable cancers could trigger a new wave of biotech company formation around next-gen CRISPR therapeutics.
